# Temple Scroll Column 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 40 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**40:1** Three thousand cubits from the temple city on every side — this shall constitute the boundary of the city.

**40:2** Beyond this boundary you may establish your houses and settlements.

**40:3** You shall not build any house or settlement within the boundary, for the area is holy.

**40:4** The boundary shall serve as a division between the holy and the profane, between the clean and the unclean.

**40:5** You shall observe this boundary as a perpetual statute throughout your generations.

**40:6** In any house in which a person dies, the house shall be impure for seven days.

**40:7** Every open vessel — any that lacks a sealed covering — shall be impure.

**40:8** Everything in the house shall be impure, and everyone who enters the house shall be impure for seven days.

**40:9** On the first day he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; on the third day he shall be sprinkled with the water of purification.

**40:10** On the seventh day he shall be sprinkled a second time; he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.

**40:11** Everything the deceased has touched — every vessel, garment, skin, and implement — shall be purified.

**40:12** Wooden vessels shall be washed; earthen vessels shall be destroyed; vessels of copper, bronze, tin, lead, and iron shall be purified with the water of purification.

**40:13** For whoever touches a human corpse and does not undergo purification defiles the tabernacle of the LORD.

**40:14** That person shall be cut off from the midst of Israel, for the water of purification was not sprinkled upon him, and he remains impure.

**40:15** His impurity persists upon him; whoever touches him shall be impure until evening.

**40:16** You shall instruct the children of Israel in all these statutes; they shall observe them and shall not defile My temple and My city, in which I dwell.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 40 establishes the 3,000-cubit sacred zone and legislates corpse contamination. The regulations are drawn from Numbers 19:11-22 with minor expansions. The distinction between vessel materials (v. 12) follows Levitical principles: porous clay vessels cannot be purified and must be destroyed; metal and wood can be cleansed.*
